sources.note: Main product page. Cloud-based EHR, browser-based, no software install. Full-service vendor with billers/developers. ONC certified.
ONC disclosure page. Lists 30+ certified criteria, Newcrop/Surescripts integration for e-prescribing with monthly costs, 16 CQMs, CCDA Web API details.
Leadership page. CEO Dr. Ignacio Valdes (psychiatrist, clinical informatics), President Janet Blazek Valdes, two senior engineers, Director of Training. Company founded 2009.
Press release about MSP-Healthcare (Arizona) joining Astronaut network in 2016. Mentions EPCS capability via Surescripts, multi-state capability.

Open Health News profile. Key details: advanced VistA version, first cloud VistA EHR, 18 years working on modernized VistA. Features: Rocket Note, Turbo Supervision, Astro-CPRS, enterprise scheduling, ADT, nationwide lab ordering, hundreds of templates.
Blue Bonnet Clinic (Houston psychiatry practice run by Dr. Valdes). Confirms Astronaut EHR is used in his own practice. Services: psychiatry, TMS therapy, blood draws, drug screens.
Dr. Valdes Doximity profile. Confirms psychiatry specialty, Houston location.
EHI export format documentation landing page. Contains link to downloadable PDF but no inline detail.
Dr. Valdes personal site. Psychiatry practice info only, no Astronaut EHR details.
VistA review/overview page. Confirms VistA core features: CPOE, lab, pharmacy, radiology, e-prescribing, scheduling, billing integration.
CPRS overview from VistApedia. Details on VistA's CPRS modules: pharmacy, lab, radiology, allergy tracking, consults, dietetics, progress notes, problem list, scheduling, vitals.
